prompts.name: hotel-hero
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide hero photograph for a fictional boutique-hotel UI concept. A serene Mediterranean coastal boutique hotel in late afternoon, pale limestone architecture with a long low terrace, turquoise infinity pool, sculptural olive trees and a calm blue sea beyond. Refined understated hospitality, natural stone and linen textures, authentic architectural photography rather than a fantasy resort. Wide16:9 landscape composition with clear depth and a generous view of pool and sea; soft luminous sunlight, warm cream and muted sea-teal palette. No people, no words, no signage, no logos, no watermark. Fictional property, concept photography.

prompts.name: olive-room

Style: natural high-end hospitality editorial photography, believable architecture, tactile linen, subtle natural imperfections, warm late-afternoon sunlight, balanced exposure, muted ivory, olive, honey stone and deep teal palette.
